name: Shahnaz Rahmatullah
contribution: Shahnaz Rahmatullah was a playback and modern-song singer whose patriotic repertoire became a major part of Bangladesh’s cultural memory.
context: She began performing at a young age, sang for film and television, and was especially associated with songs such as ‘Ekbar Jete De Na’ and ‘Ektara Tui Desher Kotha’.
impact: Her voice carried patriotic feeling across radio, film, television, and later generations, making her one of Bangladesh’s best-known patriotic singers.
highlight: Her voice became part of the soundscape of national remembrance.
